issues.quote: revenue rising 74.8% to $26.9 billion from $16.7 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Growth from $16.7B to $26.9B is about 61.4%, not 74.8%. The dollar figures are correct but the percentage is miscalculated.

data.summary: All dollar figures match NVIDIA's FY2022/FY2021 reported results, and the net income growth of 125.1% is correct. However, revenue growth is overstated: it was about 61.4%, not 74.8%.
